about_the_game:
Enjoy the numerous diverse, alien tracks of Fourmiworld in this multi-disc album - including a special six-song remix EP built right in!

Featuring a track by guest composer Chuck Salamone of Hylics 2 & Flips¿de!

From the strange & experimental songs of Wandereye's favorite artists, to the ambient, interdimensional concertos of Dimension: Planck, this comprehensive soundtrack has everything your ears & antennas could ever need!
